mapper.select: SELECT id, anonymous_id, user_id, scenario_id, version_id, current_node_id, state, started_at, last_activity_at, expires_at, ip_hash, user_agent_hash, created_at FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
mapper.sql: s.id, left(s.id::text, 8) AS session_key, s.scenario_id, sc.title AS scenario_title, s.state, s.current_node_id, s.started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.expires_at, COALESCE(count(m.id), 0) AS message_count, ( SELECT lm.content FROM chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_id = s.id ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT lm.content_ciphertext FROM chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_id = s.id ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_ciphertext, ( SELECT lm.content_key_id FROM chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_id = s.id ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_key_id, ( SELECT lm.content_encryption_version FROM chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_id = s.id ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_encryption_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_session s JOIN scenario sc ON sc.id = s.scenario_id LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.anonymous_id = #{anonymousId}::uuid AND s.created_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY s.id, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM chat_session s JOIN scenario sc ON sc.id = s.scenario_id LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.session_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM chat_session s JOIN scenario sc ON sc.id = s.scenario_id LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id}::uuid GROUP BY s.id, sc.title
WITH lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('chat_session:' || #{sessionId}::text)) ) SELECT 1 FROM lock
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET current_node_id = #{currentNodeId}, state = #{state}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_activity_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
UPDATE chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND state = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at < #{cutoff}
